transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the weekly power-support meeting. We've got four portable power units — P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 — all listed as serviceable and available. They need to cover the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area for the coming week. I'd like each of you to brief your area's needs so we can finalize the allocation and I can sign the support plan. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Colonel. I'll start. Before we make any assignments, I need to flag something important about P-2. During yesterday's electrical inspection, I confirmed that P-2 is the only unit with the recently certified isolated-output transformer that the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment requires. The certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board, so it may not be reflected there yet. I'd recommend we assign P-2 to the clinic to ensure their diagnostic equipment is properly protected.
